title: Product quality standards and defect classification
content: NorthWind Markets requires all vendors to meet quality tier standards. Defective products are classified as: cosmetic damage (tier 1), functional impairment (tier 2), or safety hazard (tier 3). Tier 2 and tier 3 defects trigger automatic return approval and vendor notification.

title: Return and refund processing guidelines
content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are processed within 5 business days of return receipt. Items must be in original packaging unless classified as defective. Defective items qualify for immediate replacement or full refund at customer choice.

title: Shipping SLA and delay escalation procedures
content: Standard shipping SLA is 3-5 business days. Delays exceeding 2 business days beyond SLA trigger automatic customer notification and shipping credit. Delays exceeding 5 business days escalate to logistics review and full shipping refund.

title: Merchant transaction monitoring and risk assessment
content: Merchant transactions are monitored for anomalies including chargeback rates exceeding 2 percent, refund rates exceeding 5 percent of monthly volume, and unusual transaction patterns. Risk scores are calculated daily and merchants exceeding thresholds enter review.

title: Data quality incident triage runbook
content: When a data quality alert fires: 1. Check source system health via API status endpoint. 2. Query metadata for last successful load timestamp. 3. Compare expected versus actual row counts. 4. If deviation exceeds 10 percent, classify as high severity. 5. If deviation is 5-10 percent, classify as medium. 6. Below 5 percent, classify as low and monitor. 7. High severity incidents require immediate team notification and pipeline pause.

title: Product catalog metadata standards
content: Every product listing must include: product name, category, subcategory, price, weight, dimensions, material, color options, and vendor ID. Enhanced metadata fields include: search keywords, customer segment tags, seasonal flags, and cross-sell product IDs. All metadata must reference the canonical product taxonomy.

title: Customer feedback classification taxonomy
content: Feedback is classified into: product_quality (defects, damage, malfunction), shipping_delay (late delivery, tracking issues), customer_service (support interaction quality), pricing_concern (price changes, value perception), return_request (return initiation, process issues), general_praise (positive experience). Each classification requires confidence above 0.75 to be accepted.

title: Pipeline anomaly detection and response procedures
content: Anomaly detection monitors: row count deviations, schema drift, null rate spikes, value distribution shifts, and freshness violations. Each anomaly type has a defined severity matrix. Critical anomalies halt downstream processing. High anomalies trigger investigation workflow. Medium anomalies generate alerts. Low anomalies are logged for trend analysis.
